# Secondary networks {#network-observability-secondary-networks}

You can configure the Network Observability Operator to collect and enrich network flow data from secondary networks, such as `SR-IOV` and `OVN-Kubernetes`.

## Prerequisites {#network-observability-secondary-network-prerequisites_network-observability-secondary-networks}

- Access to an OpenShift Container Platform cluster with an additional network interface, such as a secondary interface or an L2 network.

**Additional resources**

- [Configuring an SR-IOV network device](/openshift-docs-markdown/networking/hardware_networks/configuring-sriov-device#cnf-creating-an-additional-sriov-network-with-vrf-plug-in_configuring-sriov-device)
